verdict.rationale: Square documents online card acceptance through the Card Payments API, the Web Payments SDK and the Node SDK. It also offers prebuilt eCommerce connections that 'can be completed in just a few clicks', and personal access tokens are suitable for production use on your own account. That points to a fast path, but nothing in the pack addresses the time-bound part of the story: how long it takes from signup to the first live payment. Missing for 10: evidence of account activation/verification timelines after signup, a documented quickstart to first production payment, and independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day go-live.
